title: 6.7 Which Side of the Street?
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Find a named destination on the left or right from a clear viewpoint.
grammar_function: Ana and Luis face the same direction from the hotel entrance. The mall is on their left and the pharmacy on their right. Ana is going to the mall; she confirms the side and finds the entrance. After arrival, a clearly marked second viewpoint introduces the station and the bank without silently reversing left and right.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Find a named destination on the left or right from a clear viewpoint.
